brief: Prioritise Ashford Crossing for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). Review open work orders and re-prioritise outstanding work against the unit's ability to shed heat, completing any defects concerning failed cooling, obstructed airflow, or oil level and leaks before the event begins (SOP-016). Bring forward any overdue detailed inspection in preference to accepting the heat exposure, as the time elapsed since the last maintenance bounds how current the recorded condition is (REG-042).
